svg.title: Pip finds the square root
svg.desc: Pip makes a rectangle more square by averaging its sides. Two examples track the spectral and geometric targets from an initial side of one. Lean and Coq prove convergence for every positive starting side and area.
svg.text: “If I know the area, how long is one side of the square?”
Pick a positive area S and guess a side x. The other side is S/x.
Average those two lengths for the next guess. Repeat.
Start both guesses at 1. Read each column downward.
After one step, the guess is at least the root. Each step from there
at least halves the remaining error. Proved in Lean 4 and Coq.
